stem:
Ritu takes 120 seconds to run once around the school field.
Her teacher asks her to give this time in minutes.
What is 120 seconds in minutes?

teacher.key_rationale: 60 seconds = 1 minute, so 120 s = 120 ÷ 60 = 2 minutes (option A). B multiplies by 60 the wrong way round; C confuses the sibling unit hours with minutes; D multiplies 120 by 60 without checking the direction of the unit change.
